audit.method: SHA-256 recomputed for every audited file (tools/rec.py). All 19 inventory files were opened and identified from the cover pages (tools/survey.py). The statement pages of every Herfy filing are image-only (textless pdf p4-7 in interims, p7-12 in annual files), so every value was read from rendered pages (tools/pg.py) for six filings: FY2023, FY2024, FY2025 annual, H1 2025, Q1 2026 and H1 2026. tools/check_transcripts.py over transcripts/6002.json checks balance sheet identity, cash-flow sum and roll, gross profit, profit before zakat to net result, Q1+Q2=H1 roll and agreement of every comparative column with the original filing; all pass with no restatement found.
